calculation.description: Ranks each tradable asset's 20-session return relative to the cross-sectional median, applies a contrarian sign, and scales it by the percentile rank of cross-asset 20-day return dispersion over the trailing 60 sessions. All inputs are shifted one completed session before use.

validation.regime_notes: 20d IC by regime: 2024-2026 -0.010705 (ICIR -0.027349, 616 dates); 2027-2029 0.072151 (0.282770, 782); 2030 0.114963 (0.358782, 261); 2031-2032 0.032616 (0.097764, 336). The admission horizon is materially longer than the 10-session rebalance cadence; interpret small-universe estimates conservatively.
validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; minimum 8 valid names per date
validation.lookahead_control: Forward returns use prices shifted -60 sessions; factor is shifted +1 session and uses only completed data.
